headline: ‘Protect the water, the air, the land’: Hundreds demand halt on Box Elder data center plan
summary: Hundreds of Utahns protested at the Utah Capitol against a proposed Box Elder County data center campus, expressing concerns about environmental impacts on air quality, water supply, and greenhouse gas emissions.

headline: Standing Rock anniversary event to include music, speakers, celebrity visitors
summary: The upcoming "People of the Sun" event marks a decade since Dakota Access Pipeline protests, drawing attention back to environmental concerns raised during the unrest.
